data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for creating shortcuts on home screen, quick actions on iOS and app shortcuts on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to manage and interact with application home screen quick actions. Provides methods to initialize shortcut callbacks and set shortcut items.
use_when: You want to add home screen shortcuts or quick actions on iOS and Android
You need to handle user interactions when launching the app via a quick action
avoid_when: Your app does not target Android SDK 24+ or iOS 13.0+
You do not need native home screen launcher shortcuts
strengths: Native support for both Android App Shortcuts and iOS Quick Actions
Simple API to initialize and set shortcut items
weaknesses: Requires native resource configuration for icons (xcassets on iOS and drawables on Android)
Behavior on Android is a no-op below SDK 25
data.setup_notes: On Android, icons may need to be explicitly marked to be kept for release builds. Minimum OS requirements: Android SDK 24+ and iOS 13.0+.
